resources.string: Dictate through your Mac. It transcribes and cleans up; this phone types.
Not paired. On your Mac, run `hex labs on lan-dictation`, then `hex lan pair`, and scan the code with this phone\'s camera.
That isn\'t a Tiro pairing link.
Dictation from this phone will go to %1$s:%2$d, paired as \"%3$s\". Only pair with a link from your own Mac.

Keep your own keyboard. With a text field and the keyboard open, hold volume-down to talk and let go to finish, or double-tap it to talk hands-free and press it again to finish. A single quick press still changes the volume.

While a text field and a keyboard are on screen, hold or double-tap volume-down to dictate through your Mac. Tiro reads only the focused field, to type the text into it, and leaves the volume key alone everywhere else.
Tap here, then hold volume-down and speak.
Open Tiro to pair with your Mac.
Open Tiro to allow the microphone.
